description: This file contains the implementation of the PascalDistribution class, which models the Pascal (Negative Binomial) distribution. It includes constructors, probability mass function, cumulative distribution function, and statistical properties such as mean and variance, along with configuration details like support bounds.

classes.name: PascalDistribution
classes.description: Implementation of the Pascal (Negative Binomial) distribution, modeling the number of failures before a fixed number of successes in Bernoulli trials.

methods.name: PascalDistribution
methods.description: Constructor initializing the distribution with number of successes and probability of success, with optional custom random generator.

methods.name: getNumberOfSuccesses
methods.description: Returns the number of successes parameter.

methods.name: getProbabilityOfSuccess
methods.description: Returns the probability of success parameter.

methods.name: probability
methods.description: Calculates the probability mass function P(X = x) for a given number of failures x.

methods.name: logProbability
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the probability mass function at x.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative probability P(X <= x).

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Computes the mean of the distribution.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Computes the variance of the distribution.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the support (0).

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the support (Integer.MAX_VALUE).

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates whether the support is connected (true).
